items.raw_excerpt: Sacré plus beau village du monde par Travel + Leisure, Gordes attire chaque été des visiteurs venus du monde entier. Mais dès la mi-septembre, le village retrouve une atmosphère plus douce, idéale pour le découvrir loin de la foule.

items.raw_excerpt: From river diversion and mining to coastal land and mega projects, a group of farmers, environmentalists and entrepreneurs is reviving the idea of Vetoba, the region’s guardian deity, to build a network to protect Konkan’s land, livelihoods and way of life.

items.raw_excerpt: Maastricht has limited how Pierre Rieu can decorate his hotel in the city center, telling the son of famous musician André Rieu that his current proposal is too extravagant. Rieu had proposed to turn the historic building into a life-sized Christmas gift, with string lights and an illuminated bow. The 4-star Hotel Derlon dates from 1870 and was bought by Rieu in 2025. He had done up the hotel in the same manner last year, but the city’s Planning and...
